name: unity-runtime-invocation-table
target: Unity 2021 LTS – 6.x; runtime + editor C# scripting; FishNet 4.x networking (Tier 2, gated)
status: Fable-reviewed v1 scope plus the FishNet Tier-2 networking section. Consumed lists are grounded in the local Unity 6.5 corpus and FABLE-SCOPE-DECISIONS.md (Tier 1) and the FishNet 4.7.2 corpus verified against the validation project's 4.6.20 source (Tier 2, see resolver-facts/FISHNET-RESOLVER-FACTS.md); pending rows are explicitly marked or quarantined. Runtime consumption must stay inside the consumed sections.

consumed.note: Sections here are read by unity.ts at runtime; the fields consumed are named per section. Everything under catalogNotes is documentation-only provenance. This mirrors blender-invocation-table.json's consumed/catalogNotes split.
consumed.detection: DOCUMENTATION-ONLY despite sitting in this manifest: the marker list is hardcoded in unity.ts detect()/hasConcreteUnitySourceSignal — editing this section changes nothing at runtime. Describes project-level sufficient markers plus source evidence rules used to recognize a Unity project.
consumed.hostInvokedBases: key set (the host-invoked-base whitelist); <base>.hostInvokedMethods (engine/editor calls these by reflection, so they look dead)
consumed.serializationAttributes: attribute set → field kept live + its declared type emits a references edge
consumed.attributeEntryPoints: attribute → the decorated method/class is a host-invoked entry point (kept live); menu/path string captured where present
consumed.typeReferenceAttributes: attribute → typeof(X)/type argument emits a references edge to X
consumed.stringInvokedCallSites: DOCUMENTATION-ONLY despite sitting in this manifest: the call-site families (SendMessage/Invoke/StartCoroutine/ContextMenuItem) are hardcoded in unity.ts processStringCalls/processContextMenuItems — editing this section changes nothing at runtime. Describes callsite API → its string-literal method-name argument links to a sibling method (references). This mirrors how blender-invocation-table.json documents its hardcoded call-site behavior under catalogNotes.
consumed.fishnet: gated FishNet 4.x networking rules: fishnet.gate (per-file using-based gate), fishnet.hostInvokedBases.NetworkBehaviour.hostInvokedMethods (+includesMonoBehaviourMessages union), and fishnet.attributeEntryPoints.methodAttributes (RPC/prediction entry points). Every fishnet row only fires when fishnet.gate is open in that file.

detection.note: detect() returns true when the C# project is a Unity project. Project/file-layout markers are sufficient; source fallback requires concrete Unity base/attribute evidence. Bare using UnityEngine/UnityEditor is supporting context only and is not independently sufficient.
markers: a file named ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt exists in the project
a .cs file contains a concrete Unity host base or v1 Unity attribute in source
`using UnityEngine;` or `using UnityEditor;` may support detection only when paired with concrete source evidence

hostInvokedBases.note: A class is host-invoked only when its class-statement base is structurally one of these. Magic method names on non-host classes emit nothing. Method sets are closed, docs-grounded v1 sets; no convention or substring matching.

MonoBehaviour.detection: base list includes UnityEngine.MonoBehaviour; same-file base chains are allowed when proven in-file; cross-file base chains emit nothing

DecoratorDrawer.note: CreatePropertyGUI validated: listed on the DecoratorDrawer page in the local Unity 6.5 corpus.

AssetPostprocessor.note: Closed docs-grounded set; no OnPostprocess<Type> convention matching in v1.

AssetModificationProcessor.note: Hooks are static editor callbacks; non-static declarations emit nothing.

serializationAttributes.note: A field bearing one of these is set by the engine/inspector via serialization: keep it live and emit a references edge to its declared type when the type is a plain local/custom non-builtin name.
resolverNotes: [field: SerializeField] on an auto-property emits a liveness node referencing the PROPERTY symbol; never fabricate a backing-field node; emit nothing if the property symbol is unavailable.
Public fields of a [Serializable]/MonoBehaviour/ScriptableObject type are also serialized with no attribute, but detecting that requires Unity serializability rules and owner context; deferred.
Skip primitive, builtin, System.*, UnityEngine.*-qualified, and known external field types.

attributeEntryPoints.note: The decorated method or class is invoked by Unity/editor infrastructure, not by an in-code caller. Attribute matching accepts short and Attribute-suffixed forms with optional UnityEngine./UnityEditor. qualification; exact token only, no substring matches.

methodAttributes.note: typeof(X) ref only when an explicit typeof argument names a local/custom type; no first-parameter type inference in v1.

classAttributes.invokedBy: editor load runs the static constructor; keep the static ctor live

attributeEntryPoints.referenceKind: entry-point liveness (no target); pathArg strings captured for provenance, not link resolution in v1

typeReferenceAttributes.note: The attribute's typeof(X) argument emits a references edge to X. Skip primitive, builtin, System.*, UnityEngine.*-qualified, and known external types. DrawGizmo is a method entry point with optional typeof reference and lives under attributeEntryPoints.

stringInvokedCallSites.note: Preconditions for every call-site rule: (1) containing class provably host-based in the SAME file (direct or same-file-chained Unity host base); (2) single string LITERAL or bare-identifier nameof(M) — dotted nameof, concatenation, interpolation, variables, empty strings emit nothing; (3) exactly ONE same-class method matches — overload ambiguity emits NOTHING.

callSites.argument: first string literal or bare nameof(M)
callSites.linksTo: unique same-class sibling method only when receiver is implicit, this, or gameObject; any other receiver emits nothing; never project-wide name linking

callSites.argument: first string literal or bare nameof(M)
callSites.linksTo: unique same-class sibling method; receiver must be implicit or this
unique same-class coroutine method; receiver must be implicit or this
callSites.note: StartCoroutine(M()) is a normal static call; do not special-case it here.

callSites.argument: second string literal or bare nameof(M)
callSites.linksTo: unique same-class method on the declaring host-based class

fishnet.note: FishNet (Fish-Networking) 4.x consumed rules — Tier 2. NetworkBehaviour, ServerRpc, and TargetRpc collide by name with Unity Netcode for GameObjects (NGO) and Mirror, so EVERY fishnet row is gated per file (see gate). Facts are corpus-verified against FishNet 4.7.2 and re-verified against the validation project's 4.6.20 source (stable since 4.0). Runtime consumption reads gate, hostInvokedBases.NetworkBehaviour.hostInvokedMethods (unioned with MonoBehaviour messages), and attributeEntryPoints.methodAttributes. Full provenance: resolver-facts/FISHNET-RESOLVER-FACTS.md.

gate.note: A fishnet row fires in a file ONLY when BOTH halves hold. EVIDENCE half: the file has a real `using FishNet;` / `using FishNet.<...>;` namespace import (alias directives `using FishNet = ...;` do NOT count), OR a parsed class BASE written fully-qualified as `FishNet.Object.NetworkBehaviour` (occurrences of that token outside a base clause do NOT count). EXCLUSION half: the file has NO `using Unity.Netcode<...>`, NO `using Mirror<...>`, and NO `using Fusion<...>` — any competing stack makes the colliding NetworkBehaviour / ServerRpc / TargetRpc tokens ambiguous, so emit nothing even when FishNet evidence is also present; exclusion always wins over evidence. Applied uniformly to every fishnet row (host bases and attribute entry points alike). Directive/base evidence is read from comment-stripped, string-masked source, so a commented or string-literal using never counts.

hostInvokedBases.note: NetworkBehaviour is a GATED host base (see gate) — deliberately NOT in the top-level ungated hostInvokedBases whitelist, because the bare `NetworkBehaviour` token is shared by NGO, Mirror, and FishNet. Its host-method set is the 10 public virtual FishNet lifecycle callbacks UNIONED with the full MonoBehaviour message set: FishNet's `NetworkBehaviour : MonoBehaviour` is a framework-guaranteed chain (verified in 4.6.20 source), so Update/Awake/OnTriggerEnter/etc. are engine-invoked on it too. The union is materialised by the resolver from the MonoBehaviour entry via includesMonoBehaviourMessages, so the MonoBehaviour list stays the single source of truth (no drift).

NetworkBehaviour.detection: base list includes NetworkBehaviour (short form under an open gate, or fully-qualified FishNet.Object.NetworkBehaviour); same-file base chains are allowed when proven in-file; cross-file base chains emit nothing — identical to the Tier-1 MonoBehaviour rule
NetworkBehaviour.note: The 10 public virtual callbacks from FishNet 4.7.2 (corpus tier=free). Excludes the internal *_Internal variants and OnValidate (already a MonoBehaviour message, protected not public). OnSpawnServer/OnDespawnServer/OnOwnershipServer/OnOwnershipClient take a NetworkConnection argument; the resolver matches by name only.

attributeEntryPoints.note: The decorated INSTANCE method is invoked by FishNet's networking/prediction layer, not by an in-code caller — entry-point liveness (self-reference only, no target). Requires the declaring class provably NetworkBehaviour-based in the SAME file AND the file gate open. Short and Attribute-suffixed forms match, same token rules as Tier-1. Static methods bearing these attributes emit nothing.
attributeEntryPoints.referenceKind: entry-point liveness (no target); the RPC/prediction method is kept live via a self-reference

excludedRows.note: Present in FishNet 4.7.2/4.6.20 but deliberately NOT consumed as liveness rows. Recorded here with reasons per the emit-nothing policy.

guardAttributes.reason: ServerAttribute/ClientAttribute are GUARD attributes ('Prevents this method from running if server/client is not active') — early-return wrappers around a normal method body, NOT framework entry points. They do not make a method host-invoked, so no liveness row.

corpusSummaries.ServerAttribute: Prevents a method from running if server is not active. Can only be used inside a NetworkBehaviour.
corpusSummaries.ClientAttribute: Prevents this method from running if client is not active.

legacySyncAttributes.reason: SyncVarAttribute/SyncObjectAttribute are corpus is_obsolete=1 (legacy v3-style). Modern FishNet uses SyncVar<T>/SyncList<T> field TYPES with OnChange events, not attributes. Deferred unless a validation corpus shows real attribute usage.

unifiedRpc.reason: FishNet 4.x also ships a unified RpcAttribute ([Rpc] with a RunLocally/communication direction), corpus tier=free. Left deferred for v1: it is not in the maintainer-specified v1 attribute set and the bare `Rpc` token also collides with NGO's [Rpc] (SendTo...). Candidate for a later addition under the same gate.

eventSubscriptions.note: SyncType OnChange handlers (`_health.OnChange += OnHealthChanged;`), TimeManager event handlers (`base.TimeManager.OnTick += Tm_OnTick;`), and RegisterBroadcast handlers (`clientManager.RegisterBroadcast<T>(OnBroadcast);`) are method-group references, NOT FishNet-specific dispatch. Investigation finding: codegraph's general C# function-as-value capture (#756, CSHARP_SPEC in src/extraction/function-ref.ts — assignment_expression `+=` RHS and bare-identifier call arguments) ALREADY captures these handlers and resolves them to same-file method nodes as `references` edges via matchFunctionRef. No FishNet-specific bridge is added in this phase; it would double-emit. Coverage bound: the handler must be a same-file method that survives the function-ref gate and resolves uniquely — cross-file handlers and non-self member-value receivers stay uncovered (deliberately, per emit-nothing).
eventSubscriptions.resolverBehavior: Emit nothing new; rely on the existing general C# function_ref mechanism.

catalogNotes.note: Not read by unity.ts at runtime. Provenance, quarantine, deferrals, and false-positive guard record for behaviors hardcoded in the resolver.

baseWhitelist.description: The host-invoked-base whitelist. A UnityEngine/UnityEditor base not in this set does not make its methods host-invoked. Runtime equivalent: Object.keys(hostInvokedBases).

networking.reason: Netcode-for-GameObjects (NGO), Mirror, and legacy UNet attributes; package-specific and name-colliding. [ClientRpc]/[Rpc] (NGO + Mirror), [Command] (Mirror/UNet), and Mirror's [SyncVar(hook=...)] have no FishNet-gated home in v1.
networking.graduated: FishNet's ServerRpc, ObserversRpc, TargetRpc, Replicate, and Reconcile GRADUATED to the consumed top-level `fishnet` section, which fires only behind the per-file FishNet using-gate. NGO/Mirror ServerRpc/TargetRpc are still excluded here: the fishnet gate emits nothing in any file importing Unity.Netcode or Mirror.
networking.futureGate: For the still-deferred NGO/Mirror/UNet rows: require package evidence such as using Unity.Netcode or using Mirror plus their NetworkBehaviour base; likely sibling gated sections mirroring the fishnet one.

falsePositiveGuards.rule: A method named Update/Start/OnEnable/etc. on a class whose base is not in the whitelist is a normal method; emit no host-invoked liveness. Bases are read only from class headers.
Same-file base chains may emit when proven in-file; cross-file base chains emit nothing under the per-file extraction ceiling.
Static-only attributes on non-static methods emit nothing; ContextMenu on static methods emits nothing.
String-invoked method references require exactly one same-class method match; overload ambiguity emits nothing.
SendMessage/BroadcastMessage/SendMessageUpwards link only for implicit, this, or gameObject receivers and only to a unique same-class sibling; never project-wide name linking.
Variables, concatenation, interpolation, dotted nameof, and empty strings emit nothing.
typeof(X) and serialized field types skip primitive, builtin, System.*, UnityEngine.*-qualified, and known external types.
Match attributes by exact token with optional Attribute suffix and UnityEngine./UnityEditor. qualification; no substring matches such as MenuItemCustom.

dynamicOrOutOfScope.resolverBehavior: Emit nothing in v1 unless separately proven.
Generic type args are ordinary static type references handled by C# extraction; do not double-emit.

monoBehaviourRectTransformPair.result: Local corpus has MonoBehaviour.OnChildRectTransformDimensionsChange page/xref and Messages row; no page, xref, or search hit for MonoBehaviour.OnRectTransformDimensionsChange.

tier2Deferred.description: Unity-only asset wiring; not in v1. Requires parsing non-code YAML assets and/or the future Unity Slice Pack static scanner.
items: UnityEvent inspector wiring: scene/.prefab/.asset YAML m_PersistentCalls to method.
Animation events: .anim asset functionName to method by name.
MonoBehaviour script usage: scene/prefab m_Script GUID to script asset.
Editor callback-registration APIs such as EditorApplication.update += fn.

resolverCoverageNotes: v1 Tier 1 is code-only: base+magic-method liveness, serialization-attribute field/property liveness plus type refs, attribute entry-point liveness, typeof type refs, and conservative string-invoked sibling-method links.
Cross-file base chains, computed strings, reflection, package-specific attributes, and all Tier 2 asset wiring emit nothing.
Pending-corpus-verification rows must be verified or quarantined before unity.ts consumes them.
